description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.059 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Real-time Coinbase order book depth and market microstructure for any crypto trading pair (BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD, etc.). Returns best bid/ask spread, 24h price stats (high, low, volume, % change), top-N bids and asks with cumulative notional, order pressure ratio (bid vs ask volume), and the last 5 executed trades. Sourced direct from Coinbase Advanced Trade API — exchange-native, not CoinGecko aggregator delay. Ideal for pre-execution analysis, spread-cost estimation, and market timing.

depth.description: Number of order book levels to return on each side (bids + asks). 3, 5, or 10. Default 5.

product_id.description: Coinbase product ID in BASE-QUOTE format, e.g. BTC-USD, ETH-USD, SOL-USD, ETH-BTC, CBBTC-USDC. Case-insensitive.

name: cdp-market-depth

ask_volume.description: Total base volume across returned ask levels

asks.description: Top asks ordered best-to-worst, each with price, size (base units), and notional (USD equivalent)

bid_volume.description: Total base volume across returned bid levels

bids.description: Top bids ordered best-to-worst, each with price, size (base units), and notional (USD equivalent)

order_pressure.description: Bid volume / ask volume. >1 = more buy pressure; <1 = more sell pressure

price.description: Latest trade price (USD or quote currency)

recent_trades.description: Last 5 executed trades on this pair
